Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and backup management workflows. Network Architecture & Management: Maintain and optimize network configurations, routing, VPNs, and load balancing across hybrid cloud and on-premises environments. Ensure high network uptime, security, and low-latency connectivity between data centers and cloud VPCs. Monitoring, Observability & Incident Management: Design, scale, and refine service monitoring, alerting, and logging systems to maintain high system performance and availability. Database Administration & Optimization: Maintain, tune, and back up multi-engine enterprise databases, including Oracle DB, SQL Server, and MySQL. Ensure high availability, performance tuning, storage allocation, and data recovery procedures. Security & Compliance: Implement security best practices across all infrastructure, networking, and cloud workloads. Ensure data integrity through routine backup management, disaster recovery (DR) planning, and compliance audits. The Ideal Candidate Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). 3+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps, Infrastructure Engineering, or Systems Administration handling enterprise on-premise and cloud environments. Technical Expertise: Cloud Platforms: Hands-on experience with at least one (preferably multiple) major cloud providers: Alibaba Cloud, or Microsoft Azure OS & Scripting: Expert proficiency in Linux operating systems (RedHat/CentOS/Ubuntu) and strong shell/Bash scripting abilities. Containers & Networking: Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, HAProxy, NGINX, and load balancers. Database Management: Proven hands-on maintenance experience with relational database management systems (Oracle DB, Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL). CI/CD & Automation: Familiarity with CI/CD tools and Infrastructure-as-Code (e.g. Terraform, Ansible). Server Room Operations: Hands-on experience with data center hardware, server room monitoring, virtualization platforms (vCenter/ESXi or Proxmox), and backup solutions. Soft Skills & Mindset: Excellent problem-solving capabilities with strong collaborative skills across cross-functional engineering teams. Ability to take full ownership of projects while operating independently when needed. Strong commitment to continuous learning, exploring new technologies, and promoting DevOps best practices. Benefits At Lane Crawford you work hard and play hard while we take care of your wellbeing. Your annual holiday leave is supplemented by special leave for birthday and work anniversaries, time off to celebrate key holidays and Summer Fridays. Our enhanced medical, dental, pension benefits and life insurance give you peace of mind. And it’s true, that all our permanent staff can enjoy staff discount and visit our legendary staff sales! You can develop your skills and knowledge on the job supported by curated learning experiences at The Academy, and have the opportunity to work with, and be exposed to, a team of internationally minded professionals who will support and stretch your career development. We offer staff wellness programmes to nurture mind, body and spirit in our head office and stores. We treasure opportunities to come together, whether it’s at an office Happy Hour, networking in the "Gin Den" or our Talk of The Town Staff Parties. Personal data provided will be used for recruitment purposes only. By applying for this position, you consent to the collection, use and disclosure of your personal data to Lane Crawford Joyce Group. Your personal data will be processed in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 岗位职责 1. 承接一线升级的复杂故障，负责服务器、虚拟化、K8s 及云平台问题的 Tier 2 排障、根因分析和闭环。 2. 负责远程判断物理服务器、RAID、固件、Linux 系统、存储与网络连接的故障定位和处理。 3. 负责 VMware/KVM 等虚拟化平台的宿主机、集群、虚拟机、迁移、快照、存储和网络排障。 4. 负责 Kubernetes 集群日常运维与排障：节点、Pod、Service、Ingress、DNS、CNI、NetworkPolicy、etcd 基础问题。 5. 负责公有云/私有云 IaaS 层资源排障，包括计算、存储、网络、镜像、安全组、负载均衡等。 6. 执行服务器、虚拟化、K8s 及云资源的配置变更、版本升级、补丁评估、窗口实施、回滚和升级后验证。 7. 编写 Python/Bash 脚本或调用 API，完成巡检、日志分析、批量检查和变更辅助。 8. 输出故障报告、SOP 和知识库，必要时升级三线、云厂商或硬件厂商。 任职要求 1. 3 年以上服务器、虚拟化、Linux 或云平台运维支持经验，具备 Tier 2 复杂故障处理能力。 2. 熟悉 Linux 系统排障，掌握 CPU、内存、磁盘、网络、文件系统、RAID 等基础定位方法。 3. 熟悉 VMware vSphere 或 KVM 至少一种虚拟化平台，能处理集群、宿主机、虚拟机及存储网络问题。 4. 熟悉 Kubernetes 基础架构和网络模型，能使用 kubectl 排查节点、Pod、Service、Ingress、DNS、CNI 等常见问题。 5. 熟悉主流云平台：AWS、Azure、阿里云、腾讯云或私有云，理解 IaaS 资源及网络排障逻辑。 6. 具备配置变更、版本升级、补丁实施、回滚和验证经验。 7. 能写 Python 或 Bash 脚本，能调用 REST API 完成自动化巡检或日志分析。 8. 具备良好沟通、工单记录、文档输出和跨团队协作能力。 加分项 熟悉 Ansible、网络及防火墙 英语或者日语可沟通

review_candidates.title: Network Team Lead
review_candidates.description: Department: Product Development Location: Málaga, Spain Description Who we are Ilkari is a privately-held start-up based in Dublin, Ireland. We deliver hyper-private scale innovation and technology to safeguard and secure data, enabling true data sovereignty even as the pace of change accelerates. Our best-in-breed sovereign technology delivers privacy and control over where companies’ data resides, where it flows, and how it’s accessed. We’re here to rewrite the story of data sovereignty – empowering innovators, pioneers and visionaries to make their mark. We believe the sky is not the limit. We strive for the perfect balance of simplicity and excellence in everything we do, and we’re looking for people who are ready to join our journey and rewrite the story of data sovereignty. Role overview We're looking for a hands-on to lead the development and operation of Ilkari's network engineering capability across datacentre, cloud, customer, and corporate environments. This role combines strong technical leadership with emerging people management responsibilities, supporting the recruitment, onboarding, and development of a new network engineering team while remaining actively involved in the design, implementation, automation, and operation of the network estate. Working closely with Architecture, Infrastructure, Platform, Security, Support, Service Delivery, and the Delivery Manager, the Network Team Lead will help evolve our Network Reliability Engineering (NRE) capability by embedding automation, observability, testing, and operational resilience into everything we build and operate. What you'll do Lead and support a multisite Network Engineering team, providing technical direction, clear priorities, and day-to-day leadership while supporting recruitment, onboarding, and capability development. Design, implement, operate, and continuously improve enterprise, cloud, datacentre, and customer network services, ensuring high availability, scalability, security, and operational resilience. Drive the adoption of Network Reliability Engineering (NRE) principles by improving automation, network testing, monitoring, observability, configuration management, and operational standards. Promote infrastructure-as-code and network automation using technologies such as Ansible, Python, and GitOps principles to improve consistency, reduce manual effort, and minimise operational risk. Strengthen operational readiness by ensuring robust monitoring, synthetic testing, capacity management, and validation processes are in place before production changes and customer onboarding. Support product delivery squad models by ensuring network engineering capacity and expertise are effectively assigned across products, enabling reliable delivery and consistent technical standards. Partner with Support, Infrastructure, Platform, Security, and Change teams to improve incident response, reduce recurring issues through structured problem management, and continuously improve network reliability. Support customer onboarding and new cloud deployments by ensuring network services are operationally ready, documented, tested, and supportable before go-live. Work with the Delivery Manager to align network priorities with delivery objectives, supporting estimation, dependency management, resource planning, and predictable execution. Collaborate closely with Architecture and Security to co-create secure, scalable, and maintainable network solutions that support both technical and business objectives. Contribute to maintaining the Network Engineering skills matrix, identifying development opportunities, and supporting continuous improvement across the team. What you'll bring 7+ years of enterprise, service provider, cloud, or datacentre networking experience. Previous experience providing technical leadership or leading small engineering teams. Minimum Cisco CCNP Enterprise (or equivalent enterprise networking certification). Strong experience across routing and switching (BGP, OSPF, EVPN, VXLAN desirable). Experience supporting cloud networking within OpenStack, Proxmox, Kubernetes, VMware, or similar environments. Strong understanding of firewalls, VPNs, load balancing, network segmentation, high availability, and security best practices. Experience with network automation using Ansible, Python, APIs, Git, Infrastructure-as-Code, or similar tooling. Experience implementing network monitoring, observability, telemetry, and synthetic testing platforms. Strong operational experience across Incident, Problem, Change, Capacity, and Operational Readiness processes. Experience supporting customer-facing production environments. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Network Engineering, Telecommunications, Information Technology, or a related discipline is preferred. CCNP Enterprise or equivalent is required; CCIE or cloud networking certifications would be advantageous Strong hands-on expertise in enterprise, datacentre, and cloud networking, including BGP, OSPF, routing, switching, segmentation, VPNs, firewalls, and high-availability design. Experience supporting network services across cloud and virtualisation platforms such as OpenStack, Proxmox, Kubernetes, VMware, or similar environments. Strong capability in network automation using Ansible, Python, APIs, Git, and infrastructure-as-code or GitOps-based practices. Experience with network monitoring, telemetry, observability, synthetic testing, and performance analysis to support proactive fault detection and reliability improvement. Strong understanding of incident, problem, change, capacity, and operational readiness practices within customer-facing production environments. What's in it for you A friendly, inclusive and multicultural environment - We are made up of over 20 nationalities. Private life and health insurance for you and your family. Four weeks per year to work from anywhere for eligible employees. Gym reimbursement. Learning Pocket: annual budget for courses, tools, or certifications. Three paid volunteering days each year. Generous referral bonus programme. A hybrid working model with flexible hours. Ilkari is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from everyone and make hiring decisions on merit, regardless of age, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, marital or civil partnership status, pregnancy or maternity, race, ethnicity, national origin, religion or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, trade union membership, or any other characteristic protected by law in the country where the role is based. If you need any adjustment to the recruitment process, tell us and we will make it happen.

review_candidates.title: OT Cybersecurity Customer Support Engineer
review_candidates.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an OT Cybersecurity Customer Support Engineer based in Germany. We are looking for an experienced OT Cybersecurity Customer Support Engineer to deliver high-quality technical support for advanced industrial cybersecurity solutions. In this customer-facing role, you will help organizations protect their operational technology (OT) environments and critical infrastructure against evolving cyber threats. You will take ownership of complex technical cases, troubleshoot networking and endpoint security issues, and ensure customers achieve the best possible results from their security solutions. Working closely with customers, partners, Product Management, and R&D teams, you will contribute to resolving critical issues and improving product reliability. You will operate in an international, fast-paced environment that requires strong technical expertise, analytical thinking, and a customer-first mindset. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to industrial cybersecurity while supporting the security and continuity of essential operations. Accountabilities Provide outstanding technical support by responding to customer and partner inquiries through phone, email, and online support channels. Take ownership of technical support cases, ensuring timely investigation, effective troubleshooting, and satisfactory resolution of customer issues. Diagnose and resolve networking, endpoint security, and system-related problems ranging from straightforward incidents to complex technical challenges. Support customers with the deployment, integration, configuration, and maintenance of industrial cybersecurity products and solutions. Perform first-contact case resolution whenever possible, while proactively managing escalations and high-impact technical situations. Configure and maintain complex laboratory environments to reproduce customer-reported issues, investigate defects, and validate potential solutions. Identify and communicate product quality and serviceability issues, ensuring they are properly documented, prioritized, tracked, and resolved. Collaborate closely with Product Management and R&D teams to investigate complex technical problems and deliver effective solutions. Provide constructive technical feedback to support continuous product improvement and enhance the overall customer experience. Share technical knowledge, troubleshooting methodologies, and best practices with fellow support engineers to improve service quality and operational efficiency. Requirements At least 5 years of professional experience working with networking products, networking technologies, or related technical solutions. At least 5 years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Windows administration, configuration, and troubleshooting. Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, network protocols, connectivity, and network troubleshooting. Demonstrated experience with network security technologies, endpoint protection solutions, and cybersecurity principles. Practical knowledge of security tools, including anti-malware technologies, security processes, and threat protection solutions. Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, with the ability to investigate complex technical issues, identify root causes, and deliver effective resolutions. Experience with network defect analysis, debugging, and providing technical feedback to improve product performance. Ability to configure and manage complex technical laboratory environments for testing, troubleshooting, and issue replication. Familiarity with Operational Technology (OT) environments, industrial control systems (ICS), and industrial processes is a strong advantage. Knowledge of industrial communication protocols and OT-specific networking technologies is considered a plus. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and manage customer expectations effectively. Strong customer-oriented mindset, with the ability to handle challenging situations professionally, tactfully, and confidently. Self-motivated and proactive approach, with a strong sense of ownership, urgency, and accountability. Well-organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working independently in a fast-paced environment with minimal supervision. Curiosity and adaptability, with the ability to quickly learn new technologies and expand technical expertise. Ability to collaborate effectively with international teams and contribute to a multicultural working environment. Benefits Fully remote working arrangement within Europe. Full-time employment opportunity. Opportunity to work on innovative cybersecurity solutions protecting industrial environments and critical infrastructure. Exposure to advanced networking, endpoint security, and industrial cybersecurity technologies. Collaboration with international technical experts and cross-functional engineering teams. Opportunities to expand technical expertise in OT cybersecurity, industrial control systems, and network security. A diverse and multicultural working environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and professional development. An inclusive workplace culture that values diversity, equal opportunities, and individual contributions. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best! Why Apply Through Jobgether? Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. review_candidates.description: Description Leidos is looking to hire a Cyber Security Specialist Mid in Camp Lejeune, NC to join our SMIT program. The selected candidate will operate all aspects of Information Systems (IS) data availability, integrity, authentication, confidentiality, and non-repudiation. SMIT is the largest IT services program for the Navy. Under the Service Management, Integration, and Transport portion of NGEN-R, the Leidos team will deliver the core backbone of the Navy-Marine Corps Intranet, including cybersecurity services, network operations, service desk, and data transport. Ultimately, Leidos will support the Navy in unifying its shore-based networks and data management to improve capability and service while also saving significant dollars by focusing efforts under one enterprise network. Primary Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To Implement and monitor security measures for communication systems, networks, and provide advice that systems and personnel adhere to established security standards and Governmental requirements for security on these systems. Develop and execute Government approved security policies, plans, and procedures; implement data network security measures; operate and monitor network intrusion detection and forensic systems; conduct IS security incident handling; support Continuity of Operations Plan/Disaster Recovery (COOP/DR) plans and perform certification of IS and networks. Perform other security duties including operation of Electronic Key Management System (EKMS) and maintenance of Public Key Infrastructure (PKI). Operate Host Based Security System (HBSS), firewalls, Intrusion Prevention Systems (IPS), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), other point of presence security tools, Virtual Private Networks (VPNs), and related security operations. Perform defensive cyber operation duties including, but not limited to, ensuring workstation and server compliancy with Marine Corps McAfee Host Based Security System (HBSS) requirements; identifying cybersecurity incidents using HBSS, Tenable SecurityCenter, RedSeal, McAfee Security Information and Event Manager (SIEM), and other automated tools; operating Imperva Web Application and Database firewalls; performing forensics and remedial action on cybersecurity incidents; and reporting defensive cyber operations statistics. Basic Qualifications Bachelor’s degree with 2 years of related experience. More experience may be substituted in lieu of degree. Must possess a Security+ certification US Citizen with an active DoD Secret Clearance NGEN If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares. Original Posting November 19, 2026 For U.S. Positions: While subject to change based on business needs, Leidos reasonably anticipates that this job requisition will remain open for at least 3 days with an anticipated close date of no earlier than 3 days after the original posting date as listed above. Pay Range Pay Range $69,550.00 - $125,725.00 The Leidos pay range for this job level is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law. About Leidos Leidos is an industry and technology leader serving government and commercial customers with smarter, more efficient digital and mission innovations. Headquartered in Reston, Virginia, with 47,000 global employees, Leidos reported annual revenues of approximately $16.7 billion for the fiscal year ended January 3, 2025. For more information, visit www.Leidos.com. Pay And Benefits Pay and benefits are fundamental to any career decision. That's why we craft compensation packages that reflect the importance of the work we do for our customers. Employment benefits include competitive compensation, Health and Wellness programs, Income Protection, Paid Leave and Retirement. More details are available at www.leidos.com/careers/pay-benefits. Securing Your Data Beware of fake employment opportunities using Leidos’ name. Leidos will never ask you to provide payment-related information during any part of the employment application process (i.e., ask you for money), nor will Leidos ever advance money as part of the hiring process (i.e., send you a check or money order before doing any work). Further, Leidos will only communicate with you through emails that are generated by the Leidos.com automated system – never from free commercial services (e.g., Gmail, Yahoo, Hotmail) or via WhatsApp, Telegram, etc. If you received an email purporting to be from Leidos that asks for payment-related information or any other personal information (e.g., about you or your previous employer), and you are concerned about its legitimacy, please make us aware immediately by emailing us at LeidosCareersFraud@leidos.com. If you believe you are the victim of a scam, contact your local law enforcement and report the incident to the U.S. Federal Trade Commission. Commitment to Non-Discrimination All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, ethnicity, age, national origin, citizenship, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, pregnancy, family structure, marital status, ancestry, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law. review_candidates.title: Manager - Network Operations & Services
review_candidates.description: I. BASIC PURPOSE / JOB BRIEF: The Manager – Network Operations & Services is responsible for leading and managing the organization’s enterprise network infrastructure operations and ensuring the availability, reliability, security, and performance of all network services supporting business operations. The role oversees day-to-day network operations covering enterprise LAN, WAN, Wireless, Internet, Data Center, Cloud Connectivity, and Remote Access services while ensuring operational excellence through continuous service improvement, incident management, infrastructure modernization, network security compliance, and automation initiatives. The position is accountable for driving operational maturity, managing network support teams, overseeing vendor and service provider performance, and implementing strategic technology improvements that enhance service availability, resiliency, scalability, and operational efficiency. II. MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES: 1. Network Operations Management Manage daily enterprise network operations ensuring stable and uninterrupted network services across all business locations. Oversee network infrastructure supporting LAN, WAN, Wireless, Internet Connectivity, VPN, Cloud Network Connectivity, and Data Center network environments. Ensure network availability, reliability, capacity management, and optimal performance of critical infrastructure services. Establish operational standards and procedures for infrastructure management and service delivery. 2. Service Delivery Management Ensure delivery of network services in accordance with defined service levels and operational standards. Monitor service performance and implement continuous service improvement initiatives. Develop operational performance reporting, service dashboards, and key service metrics. Maintain service quality and improve overall end-user network experience. 3. Incident, Problem and Change Management Lead major incident management activities involving critical network outages and service disruptions. Manage incident escalation processes and ensure timely service restoration. Drive root cause analysis activities for recurring operational issues and implement permanent corrective actions. Oversee infrastructure change management activities ensuring minimal service interruption and operational risk mitigation. 4. Infrastructure Modernization and Technology Lifecycle Management Evaluate existing network technologies and identify opportunities for technology modernization and infrastructure improvement. Develop network technology refresh roadmap for replacing aging or legacy infrastructure. Recommend implementation of newer network technologies that improve scalability, security, resilience, and operational efficiency. Manage hardware lifecycle planning, software upgrades, infrastructure refresh, and technology adoption initiatives. OTHER RESPONSIBILITIES: 5. Monitoring, Automation and Operational Maturity Improve infrastructure monitoring and observability capabilities across enterprise network environments. Identify opportunities for operational automation to reduce manual intervention and improve operational efficiency. Lead automation initiatives using infrastructure automation and orchestration technologies. Drive operational maturity improvements through process standardization and continuous optimization. 6. Security and Compliance Support Ensure network infrastructure adheres to enterprise security standards and security architecture requirements. Support implementation of network segmentation, secure remote access, identity-based access controls, and network access control solutions. Partner with cybersecurity teams to ensure infrastructure security compliance and audit readiness. Ensure operational compliance with internal policies, governance standards, and regulatory requirements. 7. Vendor and Service Provider Management Manage relationships with network vendors, service providers, telecommunications partners, and third-party support organizations. Monitor vendor service performance against contractual obligations and service agreements. Participate in technical evaluations, procurement support, contract renewals, and vendor negotiations. Manage third-party escalations involving critical service-impacting incidents. 8. Leadership and Team Management Lead and develop network engineering and network operations teams to ensure high operational performance. Define team roles, responsibilities, performance expectations, and development plans. Provide coaching, mentoring, and technical leadership to infrastructure operations teams. Build a culture of accountability, operational discipline, teamwork, and continuous improvement. III. JOB SPECIFICATIONS: Educational Requirement: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Electronics and Communications Engineering, or related technical discipline. Professional certifications in networking, infrastructure management, cloud technologies, or IT service management are preferred. Experience Requirement: Minimum 8 years of experience in enterprise network infrastructure operations. Minimum 4 years of leadership or people management experience in infrastructure or network operations environment. Experience managing large-scale enterprise network environments supporting mission-critical business operations. Experience managing vendor relationships, service providers, and outsourced infrastructure support services. Strong background in enterprise network architecture, operational support, and infrastructure modernization initiatives. Skills and Attributes: Leadership Skills: Strong people management and team leadership capability. Ability to lead operational teams in high-pressure and business-critical environments. Strong decision-making and problem-solving capability. Effective stakeholder management and executive communication skills. Strong project management and service delivery leadership capability. Ability to drive operational transformation and continuous improvement initiatives. Technical Skills: Strong knowledge of enterprise routing and switching technologies. Experience managing wireless infrastructure and enterprise network architecture. Knowledge of SD-WAN, VPN, Internet, WAN optimization, and cloud networking technologies. Experience in network security technologies including firewalls, segmentation, NAC, and secure remote access. Strong understanding of infrastructure monitoring, observability, and performance management platforms. Experience with network automation tools, scripting, orchestration, and infrastructure automation technologies. Strong knowledge of incident management, problem management, change management, and service management frameworks. A strong teamwork attitude with initiative and motivational skills accompanied with prior experience in a support service role is required. Other Qualifications: Proficient in both spoken and written English. Able to learn new product updates and technologies. Strong analytical thinking and troubleshooting capability. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced enterprise environment. Strong customer service orientation and business partnership mindset.

review_candidates.title: IT and Cybersecurity Operations Manager
review_candidates.description: About The Company At Foundation Healthcare, we believe that all stakeholders in the healthcare ecosystem must work closely together to deliver better value for the patients we care for. We believe healthcare should be: accessible, affordable and accountable. Currently one of the largest multi-specialty private specialist groups in Singapore, we are supported by our proprietary technology platform and strategic partnerships. Work with us to reimagine and build out the "foundation" for modern healthcare. Our Culture We dream big. We push boundaries. All while remembering the importance of laying the right foundations to build a sustainable organization. We are a team of passionate and dynamic individuals pursuing our best daily. We respect everyone's ideas and talents, and we embrace diversity. Job Description The IT & Cybersecurity Operations Manager is responsible for overseeing day-to-day IT operations, cybersecurity activities, and IT service delivery across Foundation Healthcare Holdings and its subsidiaries. This role leads the existing IT and cybersecurity team, ensuring effective team management, timely resolution of operational issues, consistent implementation of IT and security standards, and continuous improvement across the group. Working closely with the Head of Cybersecurity & IT Operations, the role is expected to take ownership of operational execution, team performance, vendor coordination, and service delivery, while supporting the group's cybersecurity governance and compliance objectives. Key responsibilities include: Lead and manage the day-to-day activities of the IT and cybersecurity team, including workload planning, task allocation, performance monitoring, and staff development. Oversee IT support operations across HQ, clinics, and subsidiaries, ensuring incidents and service requests are resolved within established service levels. Act as the primary escalation point for operational IT issues, coordinating internal resources and external vendors to ensure timely resolution. Oversee the management and maintenance of IT infrastructure, endpoints, networks, Microsoft 365, cloud services, and other business-critical systems. Ensure consistent implementation of IT standards, endpoint security controls, asset management processes, and operational procedures across the group. Coordinate cybersecurity operations, including security monitoring, vulnerability management, incident response, and remediation activities. Work closely with external security operations providers and vendors to manage security alerts, investigations, and corrective actions. Support compliance activities relating to ISO 27001, ISO 27701, ISO 27017, CSA Cyber Trust Mark, and applicable healthcare cybersecurity requirements. Ensure operational documentation, IT asset records, risk registers, audit evidence, and corrective action tracking are maintained accurately. Manage IT vendors, service providers, procurement coordination, and technology lifecycle activities to ensure service quality and cost effectiveness. Lead and coordinate IT infrastructure upgrades, clinic technology deployments, system improvements, and cybersecurity initiatives. Work closely with clinic managers, operations teams, and business stakeholders to address technology requirements and operational challenges. Establish and monitor operational KPIs, service performance, team productivity, and recurring issues to drive continuous improvement. Provide regular operational updates, management reports, and timely escalation of significant risks or issues to the Head of Cybersecurity & IT Operations. Promote a proactive, accountable, and service-oriented IT and cybersecurity culture across the team. Desirable Attributes & Competencies Diploma or Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline. 5–8 years of relevant IT experience, including at least 2–3 years in a supervisory or team management role. Proven experience managing IT operations, technical support teams, service delivery, and external vendors. Strong technical understanding of IT infrastructure, networking, Microsoft 365, endpoint management, cloud services, and cybersecurity technologies. Experience in IT service management, incident handling, problem management, and operational escalation. Good understanding of cybersecurity operations, security controls, vulnerability management, and incident response. Familiarity with ISO 27001, IT governance, risk management, and compliance requirements. Strong leadership, communication, organisational, and stakeholder management skills. Able to prioritise competing operational demands, make sound decisions, and manage escalations independently. Hands-on and technically competent, with the ability to guide team members and troubleshoot complex issues when required. Experience supporting multi-site environments, particularly healthcare organisations, would be an advantage. Professional certifications such as ITIL, CISM, CISSP, or relevant Microsoft certifications would be advantageous Foundation Healthcare is an equal opportunity employer. We thrive on diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Data Protection Notice By proceeding to apply for the role, you understand and accept that your personal data may be processed by the Company for the purposes of processing your application as further explained in this privacy notice.

review_candidates.title: Technical Support Engineer (m/f/d)
review_candidates.description: Ververica is the original creator of Apache Flink® and remains a core contributor to it. Flink is the leading open-source engine for stream and batch processing. It runs mission-critical workloads at Netflix, Alibaba, Amazon and Uber, as well as at banks, telcos and global enterprises. We build Ververica Unified Streaming Data Platform, an enterprise-grade platform for real-time data on top of Flink. Backed by one of the world's largest tech companies, we combine open-source innovation with long-term stability. WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS Our customers run real-time pipelines that cannot stop: fraud detection, payments, telemetry, recommendations. When something breaks, you are the engineer who gets it running again. As a Technical Support Engineer , you will solve real production problems on Kubernetes, in the cloud and inside Flink itself. You will work side by side with the engineers who build Flink, so every hard ticket is a chance to learn how a distributed system works under the hood. This role suits someone who enjoys a good puzzle, likes helping people and wants to grow into a stream processing expert. Responsibilities 2+ years in technical support or a similar hands-on role, ideally with cloud-based products. Solid knowledge of at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or Google Cloud). Practical experience with containers and Kubernetes. Our product runs on Kubernetes, so this matters. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. You enjoy finding out why something fails. Clear written and spoken English, and the patience to explain technical ideas to any audience. A customer-first mindset and the ability to stay calm when a customer is under pressure. Ability to work independently and as part of a distributed team. Curiosity and a drive to keep learning. A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. NICE TO HAVE No one ticks every box. If you have some of these, tell us. Experience with stream processing, Apache Flink or Apache Kafka. Scripting or programming skills in Shell, Python, Java or SQL. Experience with Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code tools. Experience with cloud monitoring and observability tools. Cloud certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect or Azure Administrator. LOCATION AND WORKING HOURS This is a remote role for someone based between UTC-4 and UTC-7. That covers US and Canadian Eastern, Central, Mountain and Pacific time, plus Latin American countries in the same range. Your core hours follow customers' business day in the Americas. You will work closely with our EMEA support team to give customers follow-the-sun coverage. Requirements Be the first technical point of contact for customers using Ververica Unified Streaming Data Platform. Diagnose and fix issues across the stack, from Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure to Flink jobs, connectors and SQL. Reproduce tricky problems, dig through logs and metrics, and find the root cause. Escalate to Engineering and Product with clear, well-documented cases, and help shape fixes and product improvements. Explain solutions and best practices clearly to engineers and non-technical stakeholders alike. Keep accurate records of cases and resolutions in our ticketing system. Turn what you learn into knowledge base articles, tutorials and runbooks that help customers and teammates. Keep sharpening your skills in cloud technologies and stream processing, and share them with the team. Benefits Competitive compensation: salary, equity and performance bonus Remote-first culture with flexible hours Direct access to Flink core developers and a global open-source community A clear path to grow into senior support, Technical Account Manager or engineering roles Generous vacation, personal leave and wellness benefits At Ververica, we believe innovation starts with diverse perspectives. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds. If you are passionate about helping customers succeed with real-time data, we would love to hear from you. Apache Flink® is a trademark of the Apache Software Foundation.

review_candidates.title: Senior Network Design Engineer (#6013)
review_candidates.description: We are looking for a Senior Network Design Engineer to join our team! As an OT Network Design Engineer, you will be responsible for translating approved security and segmentation architectures into detailed, implementation-ready network, firewall and IDS designs across industrial environments. Your role will focus on enabling secure and resilient OT connectivity by converting security requirements, zones and conduits into practical network designs, while working closely with Network Operations, project teams and local site stakeholders to support successful implementation. Responsibilities Translate approved OT security and segmentation architecture into detailed, implementation-ready network designs. Translate defined zones, segments and conduits into VLANs, subnets, routing, firewall boundaries and network connectivity. Develop detailed firewall designs, including interfaces/zones, traffic flows, rule requirements, protocols, ports and services. Analyse firewall logs and network traffic to identify and validate OT communication dependencies. Translate approved OT IDS architecture into detailed deployment designs, including sensor/collector placement, connectivity and traffic visibility. Define SPAN/TAP and traffic-mirroring requirements required for IDS monitoring. Develop detailed designs suitable for brownfield OT/industrial environments, considering existing infrastructure and operational dependencies. Produce Low-Level Designs (LLDs) and technical documentation suitable for implementation. Work closely with Network Operations, project teams and local site stakeholders during design and implementation. Support implementation, troubleshooting and validation to ensure the deployed network, firewall and IDS configurations conform to the approved architecture and design. Requirements Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in IP networking and network design, preferably including OT/industrial environments. Strong hands-on experience with Cisco networking technologies and equipment (e.g. routers, switches, firewalls); Cisco certifications (CCNA, CCNP, CCIE or equivalent) would be a plus. Strong knowledge of IP networking, VLANs, subnets, routing and network segmentation. Strong hands-on knowledge of firewall technologies, including zones/interfaces, routing, NAT, access-control policies, logging and traffic analysis. Experience designing and implementing firewall-based segmentation in brownfield OT environments. Practical knowledge of OT/industrial networks, including Purdue architectures, industrial DMZs and industrial protocols. Experience with OT IDS technologies and their deployment in industrial networks. Understanding of SPAN, TAP, traffic mirroring, IDS sensors/collectors and network visibility requirements. Strong ability to analyse firewall logs, network traffic and communication flows. Good understanding of OT assets, protocols, services and communication dependencies. Ability to translate architecture and security requirements into detailed network, firewall and IDS designs. Strong technical documentation skills, particularly Low-Level Designs and implementation-ready network documentation. Strong collaboration skills across Network Operations, Security Architecture, project teams and local site stakeholders. We offer*: Flexible working format — remote, office-based or flexible A competitive salary and good compensation package Personalized career growth Professional development tools (mentorship program, tech talks and trainings, centers of excellence, and more) Active tech communities with regular knowledge sharing Education reimbursement Memorable anniversary presents Corporate events and team buildings Other location-specific benefits not applicable for freelancers
